{{Quote|We're Death Watch and we're here to rescue you.|This Death Watch soldier to a Mandalorian police officer|<ref name="Shades of Reason" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a '''Death Watch soldier''' took part in both a [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|mission]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]], the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|Battle]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], possibly perishing in the latter of the three.
This [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] seemed to have a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] above that of many of his fellows, as he was charged with leading a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on at least one occasion. The soldier also featured the Death Watch's rank insignia on his shoulder pads. Further evidence is that he often walked with [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], who held one of the highest positions in the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|No, thank Pre Vizsla.|The soldier to a Mandalorian police officer after the latter thanked the former for rescuing him|<ref name="Shades of Reason" />}}
In [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Eminence Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 47-50|Maul on Mandalore}}</ref> this [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] took part in the [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|mission]] to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's Palace]], where he was present at [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze's]] side. Later, after the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Families]] had joined the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], the Mandalorian helped up a resting [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] warrior in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] employment, before conversing with Kryze.<ref name="Eminence" />

[[File:DeathwatchSoldier8-SoR.png|thumb|left|300px|This Mandalorian "rescuing" New Mandalorians from captivity.]]
A short time later, the Shadow Collective developed a plan where the criminals would [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attack]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], and pretend to be subdued when the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] arrived in order to win over the favor of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|people]] of Mandalore. Another ranking member was briefed on this plan, and the soldier left with him after conversing with Bo-Katan Kryze. The plan proceeded accordingly, with a group of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] members taking captive workers and [[Police officer/Legends|police]] at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari shipping docks]] as other criminals took the residents of Sundari by surprise. This member arrived with some others, "captured" the criminals, and rescued those they had disarmed. When a [[Unidentified Mandalorian police captain (docks)/Legends|police captain]] thanked him, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] replied that the former should instead give thanks to the leader of the Death Watch, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. Later, the soldier was present when [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was defeated by Vizsla, according to plan, and helped to arrest [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and her guards.<ref name="Shades of Reason" />

Later, the soldier was nearest Pre Vizsla when [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] successfully challenged Vizsla to a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] for the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|title of Mandalore]]. Toward the end of the lengthy fight, a defeated Vizsla briefly locked eyes with this soldier before being [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by Maul a few moments later. The soldier, along with the majority of the Death Watch leaders, sided with Maul while recognizing him as the new leader of Death Watch, and temporarily gave chase to the rebels. The soldier was later visible at [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec's]] side after the latter gave a speech to the people of Mandalore.<ref name="Shades of Reason" />

[[File:Unidentified-Death-Watch-Mandalorian-White-Helmet-Shooting.jpg|thumb|right|300px|This Death Watch member firing at attacking [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]]]]
Soon after, this Mandalorian evidently had misgivings about serving under Maul and joined Bo-Katan Kryze's [[Nite Owls/Legends|rebels]]. He helped [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] so the latter could inform the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] of what had occurred on Mandalore. The soldier, however, did not enter the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] his allies used to take cover, nor did [[Unidentified Mandalorian super commando captain/Legends|another Mandalorian]] giving chase.<ref name="The Lawless" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I challenge you, one warrior to another. And only the strongest shall rule Mandalore.|Darth Maul challenges Pre Vizsla to a duel as this warrior looks on|<ref name="Shades of Reason" />}}
Being a member of Death Watch, this soldier felt strongly that Mandalore had to return to its warrior-like ways, or it would fall.<ref name="Eminence" /> As with all Death Watch members, this Mandalorian was bound by honor, and chose to side with an outsider when the Death Watch's former leader was killed.<ref name="Shades of Reason" /> Later, the soldier experienced doubt that he had made the correct decision, and defected to Bo-Katan Kryze's rebels.<ref name="The Lawless" />

Similar to most Mandalorians, this soldier was a Human male with [[Color/Legends|fair]] skin. This particular Mandalorian had blonde hair and light blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] as well as a scar running diagonally down his left cheek.<ref name="Shades of Reason" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You're all traitors.|Bo-Katan Kryze, to all Death Watch members who joined Darth Maul, including this particular soldier.|<ref name="Shades of Reason" />}}
[[File:DeathWatchElite-Eminence.png|thumb|left|300px|This warrior with other ranking officials of Death Watch.]]
This soldier wore the traditional and resilient [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|combat armor]] of the Mandalorian warriors, though in a significantly lighter shade. The warrior's helmet and jumpsuit were white, as opposed to the majority of the other Death Watch members, with the exception of Bo-Katan. The helmet was equipped with an antenna, while the uniform sported both a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and a faded Death Watch rank insignia, verification that the soldier held an esteemed rank in the Death Watch.<ref name="Eminence" /> In addition to his armor, the soldier wielded a pair of [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-35 blaster pistols]].<ref name="The Lawless" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Death Watch Warrior first appeared in "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," the fourteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]],<ref name="Explore: Eminence">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/eminence-episode-guide|text="Eminence" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> which was released on [[January 19]], [[2013]].<ref name="Eminence-TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-the-clone-wars/eminence-2631849|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Season 5 Episode 14: Eminence}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Dave Filoni]], and credited as an enforcer.<ref name="Eminence" />

During the scene where the soldier helps a Quarren to his feet, another soldier using what appears to be the exact same model can be seen conversing with Bo-Katan Kryze.<ref name="Eminence" />
